# laravelforge_ssl_certificate (Resource)

Manages an SSL/TLS certificate on a Laravel Forge site domain. Certificates are create + read + delete only (the Forge API exposes no update for them), so every input forces replacement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) ID of the domain the certificate is installed on (certificates are scoped per-domain in the new Forge SSL system).
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site the domain belongs to.
- `type` (String) Certificate type to create: `new` (CSR / Let's Encrypt), `existing` (upload key + certificate), or `clone` (copy from another certificate). Create-only.

### Optional

- `certificate` (String) Certificate body (PEM, including intermediates) for an `existing` certificate. Create-only.
- `certificate_id` (Number) Source certificate ID to copy when `type = clone`. Create-only.
- `city` (String) City / locality for a `new` (CSR) certificate. Create-only.
- `country` (String) Two-letter country code for a `new` (CSR) certificate. Create-only.
- `department` (String) Organizational unit / department for a `new` (CSR) certificate. Create-only.
- `domain` (String) Primary domain the certificate covers. Create-only.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Private key (PEM) for an `existing` certificate. Create-only, write-only.
- `organization_name` (String) Organization name for a `new` (CSR) certificate. Sent to the Forge API as `organization` (renamed here to avoid colliding with the `organization` slug). Create-only.
- `state` (String) State / province for a `new` (CSR) certificate. Create-only.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether this certificate is the active one for the domain.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `existing` (Boolean) Whether the certificate was uploaded (vs. issued by Forge).
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the certificate.
- `request_status` (String) Certificate request status.
- `status` (String) Certificate status.
